seo.title: ChatSched — Book real South African pages, podcasts, radio & venue screens
seo.description: Choose the local page, creator or channel your customers already follow. Send one request, pay only once it's approved, and ChatSched holds your money until your ad is live. No ad account, no auction.

hero.badge: LOCAL ADVERTISING · NO AD ACCOUNT · NO AUCTION
hero.subtitle: Pick a local page, creator, podcast, radio slot or venue screen. Send one request — you pay only once they approve, and ChatSched holds the money until your ad is live. Then you keep the proof.
hero.secure: Payment held until your ad is live

heroMockup.footer: You pick the placement. ChatSched keeps the request, the payment and the proof together.

twoWays.title: Do it yourself, or hand us the brief.
twoWays.subtitle: Book your own ad space in minutes — or tell us the goal, the area and the budget, and we build the campaign for you.
twoWays.agencyBody: Tell us the goal, the area and the budget. We build the plan, book the placements and run the schedule — you approve before a cent is paid.
twoWays.marketplaceBody: See exactly who you're booking, what they charge and how big their audience is. Send a request and pay only once they approve.

comparison.badge: WHY NOT JUST RUN SOCIAL ADS?
comparison.title: No algorithm. No ad account. No bidding war.
comparison.subtitle: Ad platforms sell your budget into an auction and hope the right person scrolls past. ChatSched puts you in front of the audience a real local publisher already built.
comparison.closer: Choose where your message appears — then keep the proof.

channels.subtitle: Social pages, creators, websites, podcasts and radio are open now. Township, taxi, sports, event and venue-screen inventory opens as real supply is verified — you'll see the status on every card.

local.title: Your customers are not “South Africa”. They are in a neighbourhood.
local.subtitle: Filter by suburb, province, category and channel so your budget lands where your customers actually live, work and spend.

township.title: Spaza Shops & Township Traders

transport.body: Taxi-rank and commuter-route inventory is being onboarded. Tell us your route and you'll get first access.

associations.title: Local Associations & Networks
associations.body: Reach members through chambers, trade bodies and community organisations — onboarding across the country now.

suburbs.title: Right down to your neighbourhood
suburbs.body: Filter by suburb and province to reach the streets your customers actually live on.

how.title: Exactly what happens, from your first message to seeing proof.
how.closer: Money does not move until the work does.

1.title: Send a request
1.body: Two minutes. No ad account, and no card charged yet.

2.title: Pick where you appear
2.body: Filter by suburb, category and channel — the price is on the card.

3.title: The publisher approves
3.body: They accept within 3 days, or the request closes itself. No ghosting.

4.title: You pay — we hold it
4.body: Card, instant EFT or manual EFT. The publisher isn't paid yet.

5.title: Your ad goes live
5.body: On the agreed date, in the agreed placement.

6.title: You keep the proof
6.body: Screenshot proof and a tracked link land in your dashboard.

trust.title: Your money. Your campaign. Your proof.
trust.subtitle: Both sides stay inside one workflow — that's the whole point.

payment.title: Your money is held, not spent
payment.body: ChatSched holds your payment and only releases it to the publisher after your placement is confirmed live.

verified.title: Verified people, not anonymous accounts
verified.body: Publishers are reviewed before they can list — proof of audience, proof of ownership, South African base.

tracked.title: One dashboard, start to finish
tracked.body: Requests, approvals, payment status and proof stay on one timeline. No chasing screenshots over WhatsApp.

tools.title: Tools that do the boring part for you.
tools.subtitle: Plan the reach, write the captions, size the return, track the clicks — built in, not bolted on.

pricing.title: Start without another monthly subscription.
pricing.subtitle: Once-off activation. No renewal, ever. You'll see every price before you commit a cent.
pricing.businessBody: Unlocks campaign building, managed advertising and sending requests. It includes a launch credit toward your first booking — and browsing is always free.
pricing.publisherBody: Unlocks your publisher profile and the full Network — approve requests, set your own prices, see opportunities and earnings.
pricing.commission: One flat {{commission}}% platform fee on completed bookings — the publisher keeps {{share}}%. No tiers, no deductions at payout.

publisherCta.title: You already built the audience. Now make it work for you.
publisherCta.subtitle: Your page, site, podcast, radio slot or venue screen — list it once, approve what fits, and get paid within 48 hours of going live.

final.title: Your next customers already follow someone local.
final.subtitle: Book that page in two minutes — or tell us the goal and let us build the campaign for you.
final.closer: No ad account. No auction. Money held until you're live.
